title: Chocolate Avocado Mousse
hookLine: British-inspired chocolate avocado mousse with 8 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Whisk & Combine Base Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Blend all the mousse ingredients together in your food processor until smooth. Add the cacao powder first and, as you blend, have all the ingredients to hand in order to adjust the ratios slightly as the size of avocados and bananas varies so much. The perfect ratio in order to avoid the dish tasting too much of either is to use equal amounts of both. Incorporate {m52853_1}, {m52853_2}, {m52853_3}, and {m52853_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure banana first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Fold In Flavorings & Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Taste and add a few drops of stevia if you feel you need more sweetness. Combine until completely smooth, uniform, and free of lumps before moving to the next stage. Incorporate {m52853_5}, {m52853_6}, {m52853_7}, and {m52853_8} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Chill Until Firmly Set
steps.instructionTemplate: Fill little cups or shot glasses with the mousse, sprinkle with the cacao powder or nibs and serve. Chill or freeze until completely firm and set, then portion into 4 servings and store leftovers in an airtight container.

steps.title: Freeze Solid, Slice & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Tip If you don’t have a frozen banana to hand you can just use a normal one and then chill the mousse before serving for a cooling dessert.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Add a pinch of flaky sea salt right as it leaves the oven—it makes the dark chocolate flavor taste 2x richer.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 15 mins!
